changes: Reuse metadata, directory traversal, skill inspection and native configuration validation within one scan only.
Minify the backend production bundle while retaining its source map.
Add configurable workload count, shared-skill fixture size and isolated backend idle CPU/memory sampling to the benchmark.

notes: Only native AI assets are traversed by workspace.scan; the original src-only fixture does not benchmark general project file traversal.
Per-process RSS includes runtime and mapped/shared pages and is sensitive to allocator/GC state.
Idle telemetry includes its own small sampling overhead and applies to the standalone backend, not the complete Electron application.
Startup comparisons are repeated fresh/reused app profiles without flushing OS file caches; no statistically significant startup improvement is claimed.
